notes:
Account snapshot: QuantWeave is a market-making fintech building sub-100ms decisioning for options pricing and client chat. Primary ask = low latency + tight cost control. Interested in Redwood Dedicated for deterministic throughput, but wants a hosted fall-back during spikes. Key technical constraints:
- P95 latency target: <= 60ms for short-turn scoring (prompt ~120 tokens).
- Sustained throughput target: ~200 qps for scoring pipeline, bursts to 1k qps during market open.
- Cost sensitivity: target <= $0.0008 per scoring request at typical batch sizes.
- Model preference: open LLM (Llama2/Redwood-verified), willing to accept 4-bit quantized variants if accuracy delta < 1.5% on eval set.
- Routing/fallback: must route to cheaper quantized model for non-critical flows; fall back to full-precision model for regulatory audits.
Security/compliance notes: require SSO/SAML, SOC2 attestation, KMS integration, audit logs, and EU data residency for certain client subsets.
Sales notes / voice: CTO (Arjun Kumar) — "If we can't meet p95 and predictable cost, we won't migrate." Been explicit about running realistic perf tests (not toy prompts).
Interested in Redwood Optimize: quantization advisories + batching/caching tune suggestions. Wants automated KV cache for repeated prefixes (market state) to reduce token compute.
Requested artifacts: perf run config, expected cost models, SOW draft, security questionnaire answer set.
Stated timeline: want a decision by end of Q1 if perf looks good.

requirements_summary: QuantWeave needs deterministic low-p95 latency for short prompts, predictable per-request cost under heavy burst traffic, and verifiable model quality after quantization. Wants automated caching of repeated prefix state, intelligent batching that respects 60ms SLO, and an ops dashboard showing per-route token cost and p95. Must integrate with company SSO and KMS; some datasets must remain in EU region.
poC_notes: POC scope: 72h Dedicated perf run + 3 days of live routing with hosted fallback. Deliverables: latency/cost report (p50/p95/p99), quantization impact matrix (accuracy vs token cost), suggested batching config (batch sizes by qps), caching strategy (KV cache TTLs & hit-rate sim). Acceptance criteria: p95 <= 60ms on scoring path AND model accuracy drop <= 1.5%.
technical_asks: 1) Run 3-day bench comparing full-precision, q4_8, q2_k variants on their eval set. 2) Provide per-token cost model and expected $/req for batch sizes [1,4,16,64]. 3) Show autoscaling behavior under 1k qps bursts. 4) Network egress/residency proof for EU customers. 5) KMS key rotation policy docs.
deal_risks: Legal DPA changes (timeline impact); specific GPU SKU availability for Dedicated pool during Q1; potential accuracy regression on heavy quantization; procurement budget constrained if ARR > $250k before end of Q1.
